rules.title: Type/const variable substitution
rules.statement: During monomorphization, a type whose kind is TypeVar or ConstVar is replaced by the binding for its name in the active substitution map; a name with no binding is left unchanged.

rules.title: Array size const-generic resolution
rules.statement: For [T; N] where N is a symbolic const param: if the substitution binds N to a const value, the array size becomes that literal and the symbolic size is dropped; if N binds to another ConstVar, the size stays symbolic under the new name; the element type is substituted recursively.

rules.title: [T; sizeof...(P)] resolves to pack length
rules.statement: An array size written as sizeof...(P) (lowered to the symbolic form '__sizeof_pack:P') is resolved at monomorphization to the literal length of the concrete expansion of pack P.

rules.title: &/* over ?Sized binding to [U] canonicalizes to Slice
rules.statement: When a ?Sized type parameter behind &T, &mut T, *const T or *mut T is substituted with an unsized slice type, the pointer type canonicalizes to the fat-pointer slice type &[U] (Kind::Slice).
rules.divergence: Logos-internal DST canonicalization step; not a user-visible Rust divergence.

rules.title: &/* over ?Sized binding to dyn canonicalizes to TraitObject
rules.statement: When a ?Sized type parameter behind a pointer/reference is substituted with an unsized dyn type, the pointer type canonicalizes to a fat trait-object pointer (Kind::TraitObject) carrying the trait name and its type args.

rules.title: Pointer to a custom-DST struct becomes a fat DstRef
rules.statement: A &/&mut/*const/*mut to a struct that is a custom-DST canonicalizes to a fat reference (Kind::DstRef) preserving struct name, package, mutability and type args. A struct is a custom-DST if its template is flagged is_dst, or if a generic instantiation binds the struct's trailing type-param (whose template field is exactly that bare param) to an unsized type-arg: UnsizedDyn, UnsizedSlice, or a bare `dyn` TraitObject (owning kind Borrow). A sized fat-handle arg (Box/Rc/Arc<dyn>, &[T]) does NOT make the instance a DST.

rules.title: Raw pointer to #[self_describing] DST stays thin
rules.statement: A raw *const/*mut to a #[self_describing] DST struct (whose tail length is recoverable from an in-band prefix field) stays a thin 8-byte pointer and is NOT canonicalized to a fat DstRef; &/&mut to such a struct keep the fat representation.

rules.title: Generic struct/enum instantiation recorded for monomorphization
rules.statement: Substituting a struct/zoned-struct or enum recurses into each type-arg; each fully-substituted concrete struct/enum instantiation is recorded as a needed monomorphization. A non-generic-args enum still records its need; enum substitution preserves the enum's package name.

rules.title: Variadic tuple pack splicing
rules.statement: A single-element tuple Tuple<[TypeVar(A)]> whose variable A maps (via the substitution map or the active pack set) to a concrete tuple is replaced in-place by the spliced, recursively-substituted elements of that tuple; e.g. &(A...) becomes &(T1, T2, ...).

rules.title: Substitution descends into fn/closure signatures
rules.statement: For FnItem, FnPtr and Closure types, each parameter type and the return type are substituted recursively; e.g. fn(T, U) -> V monomorphizes its argument and result types.

rules.title: Associated type projection resolution
rules.statement: An associated type Trait::Base::Assoc is resolved by first substituting Base; if Base resolves to a struct, enum, or scalar primitive, the concrete impl's associated type binding is looked up by key 'Trait::ConcreteBase::Assoc' and the result is recursively collapsed. Scalar primitives use their canonical type name as the base, enabling resolution through the Primitive→Container blanket chain.

rules.title: Associated type resolution via satisfied blanket impl
rules.statement: If no direct impl supplies the associated type, a blanket impl `impl<T: Bound> Trait for T` is used when the concrete base satisfies Bound and all extra bounds (each checked recursively for an impl); the blanket's associated-type binding is substituted with the blanket type-var bound to the concrete base.

rules.title: <type:CFG.path> Writ config-slot type projection
rules.statement: A CfgSlotType <type:CFG.path> resolves by substituting CFG to a WStaticLit, looking up the bound Writ literal value, and walking the encoded path (F=string-keyed map field, I=integer-keyed map field, A=array index). If the reached Writ value is a Type, it yields the corresponding scalar primitive (u8..f64,bool) or the named struct/enum from the program; otherwise the projection stays deferred (unchanged). The path is a 0x1F-joined sequence of (kind-byte + payload) steps.
rules.divergence: Logos addition: compile-time type extraction from a Writ static configuration value; no Rust equivalent.
rules.uncertainty: Path encoding details inferred from the in-file comment and decoder.

rules.title: Substitution is identity when nothing changes
rules.statement: For every aggregate type kind, substitution returns the original type unchanged when no contained type-arg/element/pointee/size changed, allocating a new type only when a sub-component was rewritten.
